name: Write and refine rap and hip-hop lyrics
description: Users primarily asked to write, complete, or modify rap and hip-hop lyrics, often specifying themes, rhyme schemes, flow constraints, or artist styles. Some requests involved filling in missing lines, adapting existing texts into rap formats, or generating lyrics in specific languages within the hip-hop genre.
